# `mise bootstrap generations`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap generations [FLAGS] [SUBCOMMAND]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap/generations.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap/generations.rs)

Inspect the operations bootstrap recorded

Every mutating bootstrap command records a pair of history checkpoints:
the tracked files before the run and after it, with a journal of what
the run changed. This lists those operations, newest first; `mise
history` lists every checkpoint.

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-n --limit <LIMIT>`** — Show at most this many operations (0 for all)

  **Default:** `20`
- **`--pending`** — Only list operations whose run did not finish
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`mise bootstrap generations diff [FLAGS] <A> [B]`](/cli/bootstrap/generations/diff.md)
- [`mise bootstrap generations ls [FLAGS]`](/cli/bootstrap/generations/ls.md)
- [`mise bootstrap generations show [-J --json] [--files] [ID]`](/cli/bootstrap/generations/show.md)

Examples:

```
mise bootstrap generations
mise bootstrap generations --json | jq '.[0]'
mise bootstrap generations show latest
mise bootstrap generations show 12 --files
mise bootstrap generations diff 11 12 --patch
```
